mandatories.anchor: Το κι βίζουαλ πρέπει να φωνάζει καλοκαίρι

open_questions.gap: The stated primary goal is spoken as the collapsed phrase «μπραντ αγουέρνες»; the intended term is not confirmed.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The whole brief is built around this objective, so it must be the client's actual goal and not a transcription guess.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Όταν λέτε ότι το βασικό για εσάς είναι το «μπραντ αγουέρνες», τι ακριβώς εννοείτε ως στόχο για το Meltemi Fizz στην κατηγορία sparkling tea;

open_questions.gap: No success metric or target (sales or awareness) exists yet; the client said nothing is written down.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without a measurable target we cannot define what success means or how the campaign will be evaluated.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιος είναι ο στόχος επιτυχίας του launch, σε πωλήσεις ή σε awareness, και πότε μπορούμε να τον ορίσουμε μαζί;

open_questions.gap: The key visual direction (summer, but premium summer) was given with a garbled term for 'key visual'; unclear whether it is a firm rule or a preference.
open_questions.why_it_matters: A creative rule that is missed or misread can send the whole visual concept in the wrong direction.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε ότι το key visual πρέπει να εκφράζει «premium καλοκαίρι»; Είναι υποχρεωτική οδηγία ή προτίμηση, και υπάρχουν άλλα δεδομένα που πρέπει να τηρήσουμε;

open_questions.gap: Deliverables are vague ('some videos and social stuff'); no formats, quantities or channels were decided. A TikTok dance idea was floated as a personal thought, not discussed internally.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Scope, production cost and timeline all depend on the number and format of assets.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποια formats και πόσα assets περιμένετε για video και social; Και το TikTok dance concept είναι κάτι που θέλετε να εξετάσουμε ή να το αφήσουμε εκτός;

open_questions.gap: The launch timing was only confirmed as 'somewhere there — autumn' in reply to the RFP's October; no specific date was given.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The launch date drives the production schedule and every upstream milestone.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Το launch είναι για τον Οκτώβριο όπως έγραφε το RFP, ή υπάρχει συγκεκριμένη ημερομηνία μέσα στο φθινόπωρο;

open_questions.gap: The board meeting is described as 'late in the month', a relative expression, and it is unclear exactly what the board will finalise (timing, budget or the brief).
open_questions.why_it_matters: The board decision may gate the start of work and the confirmation of budget and dates.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Όταν λέτε «τέλη του μήνα» για τη συνεδρίαση του board, εννοείτε τέλη Ιουλίου 2026; Και τι ακριβώς θα οριστικοποιηθεί εκεί;

open_questions.gap: The figure is a hedged range spoken aloud ('ογδόντα, μπορεί ογδόντα πέντε') with unstated currency and units, and it excludes media spend.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Scope and production ambition depend on knowing what amount this is and what it covers (VAT, currency, production only).
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε: το 80–85 αφορά χιλιάδες ευρώ και μόνο production, χωρίς media spend και χωρίς ΦΠΑ;

open_questions.gap: The media spend budget is unknown; it is handled separately with the client's media shop and the CFO does not yet own that number.
open_questions.why_it_matters: The channel mix and the total campaign investment cannot be planned without the media envelope.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιο είναι το budget για media spend και ποιος από το media shop σας μπορεί να μας το επιβεβαιώσει;

internal_conflicts.note: Same speaker floated metro-station OOH and then explicitly retracted it within the same turn ('scratch that ... Ξεχάστε το'), citing cost. Explicit, settled reversal; the idea is not carried as a deliverable.
